card.title: Say You’re Sorry
card.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put your usual mug out. We can still have tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Still? Are you cross with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm hoping you won't leave me cross.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you feel that way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you try one where you're sorry about yourself? I'll keep the tea warm.

mechanism: A uses strained hospitality and wording correction to elicit an apology while leaving the offense unnamed.
confusable: Unlike explaining a grievance, A must make remorse the repair without saying what B did.
comparison: D03-a rejects a feelings-only apology; D03-b turns an emoji into a request for spoken first-person remorse.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
